g.text: Key cities across the Japanese archipelago
Over 91% of the population lives in urban areas.
Renowned for advanced tech, automotive & culture.

Japan is an island country in East Asia located in the northwest Pacific Ocean. It is bordered by the Sea of Japan to the west and extends from the Sea of Okhotsk in the north to the East China Sea in the south. As a global leader in technology, industrial manufacturing, and cultural exports, Japan balances ancient traditions with pioneering modern infrastructure across its mountainous terrain.
